description: This PHP class defines an OpenCart admin dashboard controller named Recent, responsible for displaying recent orders and managing dashboard settings related to the 'Recent' widget. It handles rendering the dashboard interface, saving configuration changes, and fetching recent order data for display.

classes.name: Recent
classes.description: Controller for the 'Recent' dashboard widget in OpenCart's admin interface, enabling display and configuration of recent orders.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the recent orders dashboard view and prepares data including breadcrumbs, configuration, and view components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of dashboard configuration settings, with permission check and returning success or error as JSON.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Fetches the latest 5 orders and returns a view with the recent order data for display in the dashboard.
